csharpDecisions: Parse project and workspace values with separate presence; missing and unknown options fail at encounter; conflict checked after parsing.
Only absent explicit options trigger independent project/workspace ancestor discovery. Enclosing workspace wins even from nested member project directory.
Resolution loads every validated workspace member in ordinal package-name order without requiring a build package selection. Reuse the same graph traversal and workspace member confinement rules.

Workspace lock belongs to workspace directory; explicit project lock belongs to project directory. Ensure refreshes stale lock using exact deterministic format2; CLI reports package count and lock path.
slgDecisions: Shared manifest-entry ancestor search serves both manifest kinds, preserves owned paths and returns explicit path errors.
Workspace load and loadForResolution share one loader core, keeping build selection-required diagnostics while resolution selects first ordinal member.
Resolve CLI shares existing dependency graph and ensureAt; no replacement package/lock parser or shell wrapper.
